title: Roasted Chicken From Jonathan Waxman
description: This deceptively unadorned but deeply flavorful roasted chicken is served with a salsa verde of capers, anchovies, and garlic, as well as various chopped herbs, such as parsley, cilantro, arugula, basil, tarragon, oregano, or sage.
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper
1/4 cup snipped chives (or a little onion or shallot)
1/4 cup salt-packed capers, soaked in cold water for 1 hour and drained
directions: Using kitchen scissors, cut out the backbone. Flatten the chicken and break the breast bone. Cut the chicken in half through the breast and season with salt and pepper. Set the chicken skin side up in an oiled roasting pan and drizzle with the oil; add the lemon halves to the pan and roast for 35 minutes, basting every 7 minutes, until just cooked through (155 degrees for the breast, 165 for the thighs).

Meanwhile, make the salsa verde. In a food processor, pulse the capers with the anchovies and garlic until finely chopped. Add all of the remaining ingredients and pulse to combine. Season with salt. Serve the chicken with the salsa verde and the roasted lemon.
